doc.english: Provides selected STS RPC operations generated from pinned metadata. Clients are concurrency safe; inputs are copied. Shared runtime errors and cancellation preserve their identity. Coverage is limited to the listed operations and fields.
doc.chinese: 由固定元数据生成选定 STS RPC 操作。客户端并发安全，输入被复制；共享运行时保留错误及取消的身份。覆盖限于列出的操作和字段。

doc.english: Contains the temporary access key identifier.
doc.chinese: 包含临时访问密钥 ID。

doc.english: Contains the temporary signing secret; it must never be logged.
doc.chinese: 包含临时签名密钥，禁止记录到日志。

doc.english: Contains the STS security token; no fixed maximum length is assumed.
doc.chinese: 包含 STS 安全令牌，不假定固定最大长度。

doc.english: Contains the parsed RFC3339 service expiration.
doc.chinese: 包含解析后的服务 RFC3339 到期时间。

doc.english: Specifies the required RAM role ARN, for example acs:ram::123456789012:role/example.
doc.chinese: 指定必填 RAM 角色 ARN，例如 acs:ram::123456789012:role/example。

doc.english: Specifies a required audit session name of 2..64 ASCII characters.
doc.chinese: 指定必填审计会话名称，长度为 2..64 个 ASCII 字符。

doc.english: Specifies the token lifetime; zero omits it (service default 3600), nonzero must be at least 900. The role maximum is a service decision.
doc.chinese: 指定令牌有效期；零值省略（服务默认 3600），非零至少为 900。角色最大值由服务决定。

doc.english: Specifies an optional restrictive JSON object policy limited to 2048 bytes; empty omits it.
doc.chinese: 指定可选的限制权限 JSON 对象策略，最多 2048 字节；空值省略。

doc.english: Specifies an optional external identity of 2..1224 ASCII characters; empty omits it.
doc.chinese: 指定可选外部身份，长度 2..1224 个 ASCII 字符；空值省略。

doc.english: Contains the source identity retained through role chaining; empty input omits it, otherwise 2..64 ASCII characters and no reserved prefix are accepted.
doc.chinese: 包含角色链保留的源身份；空输入省略，否则要求 2..64 个 ASCII 字符且不使用保留前缀。

doc.english: Contains the source identity retained through role chaining; empty input omits it, otherwise 2..64 ASCII characters and no reserved prefix are accepted.
doc.chinese: 包含角色链保留的源身份；空输入省略，否则要求 2..64 个 ASCII 字符且不使用保留前缀。

doc.english: Executes one RPC request through the shared runtime; nil input uses zero values unless required. Callers must not mutate input concurrently.
doc.chinese: 通过共享运行时执行一次 RPC 请求；除必填输入外，nil 输入使用零值。调用者不得并发修改输入。
